title: Attempt log and attempt event ids (Caducus accepts delivery:<id>:a<N>)
description:
A retry is an attempt. The attempt log on a Delivery only grows; each entry has number, time, Caducus event id, outcome, provider code. Attempt N is one Caducus event with id delivery:<deliveryId>:a<N>, replacing today's round suffix. Small Caducus change to accept the id shape. A pause, budget stop or rate limit ends an attempt; the next try is the next attempt. An attempt sequence ends on a clear provider answer (sent, refused, or for X after an unknown outcome the read that shows whether the post exists); no invented retry count.

**Acceptance criteria**
- Gherkin: A retry is an attempt (a failed then a successful attempt is one Delivery with two entries; pause or budget stop ends an attempt and the next try is the next attempt; earlier entries never change).
- Caducus accepts and de-duplicates on delivery:<id>:a<N>; the round suffix is removed from Papyrus and Caducus.
- Released through the Caducus release path with its own specs.

Design: ~/Projects/papyrus-announcement-delivery-design.md. X feed stays OFF. No real email addresses in specs or fixtures. Every behaviour change ships with narrative Gherkin specs.
